title: Spinach and Feta Bread Bake
subtitle: savoury bread pudding with spinach and Bulgarian cheese
description: A savoury bread pudding made from day-old sweet bread or croissants soaked in a spinach, egg and milk custard with feta, rested overnight and baked until golden.

steps.text: Cut the bread into thick slices (cut croissants lengthwise). Arrange tightly in an ovenproof dish with the inner side facing up.
Mix the spinach, eggs, milk, salt, pepper and nutmeg and pour over the bread. Crumble the feta on top. Cover with cling wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
Before serving, preheat the oven to 180°C and bake for 45 minutes until the cheese is golden. A few minutes before the end of baking, sprinkle over a little parmesan.
